executive_summary: For Alpha Steel Ltd (GB), total greenhouse gas emissions for the reporting period 1 January 2024 to 31 December 2024 were 47,500.0 kgCO2e, comprising Scope 1 emissions from natural gas combustion of 13,500.0 kgCO2e and Scope 2 emissions from purchased electricity of 34,000.0 kgCO2e. Activity data inputs were 170,000.0 kWh of electricity consumption and 75,000.0 kWh of natural gas consumption. Based on a production volume of 12,000.0 units, the resulting emissions intensity is 3.9583333333333335 kgCO2e per unit. Overall data quality confidence is 88.33 against a target of 95.0. Electricity consumption and production volume are both below the target confidence threshold and should be treated as lower-confidence inputs in any audit assessment.
limitations: This report is limited to the inputs and outputs contained within the provided data packet. Coverage is restricted to Scope 1 emissions from natural gas combustion and Scope 2 emissions from purchased electricity; no additional emission sources or scopes are included. Overall data quality confidence of 88.33 falls below the 95.0 target, with electricity_kwh and production_units both flagged as low-confidence inputs. The prior conflict on electricity_kwh, resolved by human selection of the utility statement, may reduce audit assurance notwithstanding the selection of an authoritative source document.
